label: Left Double
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Real cloth photograph, not line art. Two separate worked buttonholes are clearly visible on a single lapel, stitched in contrasting teal thread and stacked one above the other roughly parallel to the lapel edge - a count of 2 on one lapel, matching 'Left Double'. The welt breast pocket with pocket square sits directly below on the same forepart, which places that forepart on the wearer's left chest, so the doubled buttonholes are on the left lapel.

Real photograph of a worn jacket. Exactly two worked buttonholes, stitched in white thread, sit one above the other on the same lapel - the doubled count the label names. Orientation is independently verifiable: the shirt's button side faces the viewer's left (so wearer's right), and the welt breast pocket sits on the jacket panel at the viewer's right, i.e. the wearer's left chest - the same panel carrying the two buttonholes. So this is unambiguously a left lapel with two buttonholes.
